summary: Ranking sync treats limit as the rank offset topanime.php/topmanga.php actually implement: the first request sends offset 0 and each subsequent request advances it by 50.
reason: topanime.php and topmanga.php address the list by rank offset published in limit (limit=50 starts at rank 51). Sync used limit as a page size and advanced a separate page parameter, so the first request skipped ranks 1-50 and later requests repeated the same window. There is no separate offset parameter, so the offset travels in cursorParam (limit), limitParam stays empty, and syncPaginationParams must send 0 rather than the stride on the first page — the endpoint command's spec default is 50, so omitting the parameter is not offset 0.
validated_outcome: go test ./internal/cli/ -run 'TestRankingPaginationUsesRankOffset|TestRankingSyncSendsRankOffsetZero' asserts the helper parameter sequence and drives the real sync command against a local server, where the first ranking request must carry limit=0 and each later request must advance the offset by 50 without repeating a window.
